english: {other}, back home they have {sci_total} science points. | {other}, the lab is up to {sci_total} science points.

english: {contracts}. And they all want them yesterday. | {contracts} contracts. I'm not counting them again.

english: {other}, that's thanks to me. | {other}, nobody knows your name.

english: Battery at {ec} percent, {other}.

english: Finally! I'm turning the coffee maker on. | Then put some music on. The good stuff.
